exposure: expert panel review of perinatal death certificates
initial ICD-PM codes assigned on death certificates
outcome: percentage of unknown causes of perinatal death
attribution of stillbirths to maternal causes
cohort: The study participants were 41 perinatal death cases (32 stillbirths and 9 neonatal deaths) from Umm al-Benin Hospital in Mashhad, Iran, whose death certificates were reviewed by an expert panel.
finding: Expert panel review effectively reduced the percentage of unknown causes of perinatal deaths, successfully identifying 80% of previously unknown stillbirth causes and increasing the attribution to maternal causes by 78%.
